title: 5ON5 - Let You Go
htmlContent:
Berlin-based band 5ON5 embodies the title on their new song “Let You Go”. You feel their presence immediately, as they takes command over this soulful production, with a masterful execution in the flow to make it all hit just right. The writing is strong and focused, with them not letting up for a second to give the listener a real view into their story, that makes you take it on as your own.
